queries: SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk FROM (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.location ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.location) <> '' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location) t WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk, event_id

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.location) <> ''
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location
), ranked AS (
  SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_ratio DESC) AS rnk
  FROM ev
)
SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk AS rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY location, rnk, event_id;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 give a NULL ratio (SQLite division by zero) and are ignored by AVG; an event whose lines all have NULL ratios has a NULL average and ranks last in its location.
Events with a NULL or blank/whitespace-only location count as having no recorded location and are excluded.
Ranks are computed among only the events that have budget lines (inner join), as the request says.
